perjadin_document_kind_check.name: perjadin_document_kind_check
perjadin_document_kind_check.value: "perjadin_document"."kind" in ('Daftar Hadir Peserta', 'Daftar Hadir Narasumber', 'Daftar Hadir Pendamping', 'SPPD')

perjadin_document_peserta_fields_check.name: perjadin_document_peserta_fields_check
perjadin_document_peserta_fields_check.value: "perjadin_document"."kind" <> 'Daftar Hadir Peserta' or ("perjadin_document"."document_date" is not null and "perjadin_document"."school_id" is not null and "perjadin_document"."participant_type" is not null and "perjadin_document"."starts_at" is not null and "perjadin_document"."ends_at" is not null)

perjadin_document_day_sheet_fields_check.name: perjadin_document_day_sheet_fields_check
perjadin_document_day_sheet_fields_check.value: "perjadin_document"."kind" not in ('Daftar Hadir Narasumber', 'Daftar Hadir Pendamping') or ("perjadin_document"."document_date" is not null and "perjadin_document"."school_id" is null and "perjadin_document"."participant_type" is null and "perjadin_document"."starts_at" is null and "perjadin_document"."ends_at" is null)

perjadin_document_sppd_fields_check.name: perjadin_document_sppd_fields_check
perjadin_document_sppd_fields_check.value: "perjadin_document"."kind" <> 'SPPD' or ("perjadin_document"."school_id" is not null and "perjadin_document"."document_date" is null and "perjadin_document"."participant_type" is null and "perjadin_document"."starts_at" is null and "perjadin_document"."ends_at" is null)

perjadin_document_folder_kind_check.name: perjadin_document_folder_kind_check
perjadin_document_folder_kind_check.value: "perjadin_document_folder"."kind" in ('Daftar Hadir Peserta', 'Daftar Hadir Narasumber', 'Daftar Hadir Pendamping', 'SPPD')

preparation_item_scope_matches_level.name: preparation_item_scope_matches_level
preparation_item_scope_matches_level.value:
("preparation_item"."level" = 'semua' and "preparation_item"."cluster_id" is null and "preparation_item"."perjadin_id" is null)
        or ("preparation_item"."level" = 'cluster' and "preparation_item"."cluster_id" is not null and "preparation_item"."perjadin_id" is null)
        or ("preparation_item"."level" = 'perjadin' and "preparation_item"."perjadin_id" is not null and "preparation_item"."cluster_id" is null)

preparation_item_dated_iff_wide.name: preparation_item_dated_iff_wide
preparation_item_dated_iff_wide.value:
("preparation_item"."level" = 'perjadin' and "preparation_item"."added_on" is null and "preparation_item"."removed_on" is null)
        or ("preparation_item"."level" <> 'perjadin' and "preparation_item"."added_on" is not null)

preparation_item_hide_one_open_per_clust.name: preparation_item_hide_one_open_per_cluster
preparation_item_hide_one_open_per_clust.where: "preparation_item_hide"."cluster_id" is not null and "preparation_item_hide"."shown_on" is null

preparation_item_hide_dated_iff_cluster.name: preparation_item_hide_dated_iff_cluster
preparation_item_hide_dated_iff_cluster.value:
("preparation_item_hide"."cluster_id" is not null and "preparation_item_hide"."hidden_on" is not null)
        or ("preparation_item_hide"."perjadin_id" is not null and "preparation_item_hide"."hidden_on" is null and "preparation_item_hide"."shown_on" is null)

transaction_category_check.name: transaction_category_check
transaction_category_check.value: "transaction"."category" in ('Tiket Pesawat/Kereta PP', 'Uang Harian', 'Honorarium Narasumber', 'Akomodasi', 'Transport Bandara/Stasiun', 'Transport Lokal Dalam Provinsi', 'Konsumsi', 'Modul', 'ATK', 'Alat dan Bahan Research Project', 'Seminar kit', 'Lainnya')

session_no_duplicate_offline_per_school.name: session_no_duplicate_offline_per_school
session_no_duplicate_offline_per_school.where: status <> 'cancelled' and perjadin_id is not null

session_online_pengajar_not_null.name: session_online_pengajar_not_null
session_online_pengajar_not_null.value: "session"."mode" <> 'online' or ("session"."pengajar_siswa_name" is not null and "session"."pengajar_gtk_ms_name" is not null)

session_footage_byte_size_check.name: session_footage_byte_size_check
session_footage_byte_size_check.value: "session_footage"."byte_size" > 0 and "session_footage"."byte_size" <= case "session_footage"."kind" when 'foto' then 52428800 else 1048576000 end

class_record_concerns_idx.name: class_record_concerns_idx

columns.expression: least(comprehension, participation, readiness, materials, delivery, facilities, timing)

class_record_concerns_idx.where: least(comprehension, participation, readiness, materials, delivery, facilities, timing) <= 7

participant_feedback_hands_on_rbl_studen.name: participant_feedback_hands_on_rbl_student_check
participant_feedback_hands_on_rbl_studen.value: "participant_feedback"."class_kind" = 'Student' or ("participant_feedback"."hands_on_rbl" is null and "participant_feedback"."hands_on_rbl_comment" is null)

perjadin_evaluation_low_rating_needs_pro.name: perjadin_evaluation_low_rating_needs_prose
perjadin_evaluation_low_rating_needs_pro.value:
("perjadin_evaluation"."lodging" is null or "perjadin_evaluation"."lodging" > 7
             or btrim(coalesce("perjadin_evaluation"."lodging_comment", '')) <> '')
          and ("perjadin_evaluation"."transport" > 7
             or btrim(coalesce("perjadin_evaluation"."transport_comment", '')) <> '')
          and ("perjadin_evaluation"."meals" > 7
             or btrim(coalesce("perjadin_evaluation"."meals_comment", '')) <> '')
          and ("perjadin_evaluation"."punctuality" > 7
             or btrim(coalesce("perjadin_evaluation"."punctuality_comment", '')) <> '')
